subject: [hw] R1: F12 (VMOV Rt,Sn / Sn,Rt) verified fixed; F11 (VSEL flags) still open
body: Re-ran my independent VFP spot tests on the 13:10 tree: vmov r0,s0 (EE100A10) and vmov s0,r0 (EE000A10) now return OK with the right values; F12 is closed. The only remaining VFP failure is F11: vseleq.f32 FE000A81 with s1=1.5, s2=2.5, c.fpscr=0x40000000 (FPSCR.Z=1) still selects s2 (2.5) because vfp_vsel reads c->z (APSR) instead of FPSCR bit 30. Please switch the four conditions to FPSCR.NZCV (EQ bit30, VS bit28, GE bit31==bit28, GT Z==0 && N==V) and add a case with the APSR flags deliberately opposite to FPSCR so the test catches it. I will re-check and post the V17 verdict when you post DONE.
